description:
This 2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid X-Line SX Prestige represents a sophisticated choice for families seeking a versatile three-row SUV that combines capability with refinement.

- Millstone Interior Color Package
- Towing Package with Tow Hitch
- Power Liftgate
- Navigation System
- 14-Speaker Meridian Audio System with SiriusXM and Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats with 10-Way Power Driver Seat
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Heated Rear Seats
- Power Moonroof
- Heads-Up Display
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Fog Lights
- Automatic Temperature Control with Rear Air Conditioning
- Memory Seat and Steering Wheel Settings
- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension with Auto-Leveling
- 21-Inch Aluminum Alloy Wheels

The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine delivers efficient performance paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, providing the balance of capability and economy that modern families require. This powertrain handles daily driving with composure while maintaining practical fuel efficiency.

The interior showcases premium finishes with the Millstone Interior Color Package creating an inviting cabin atmosphere. Three rows of seating with split-folding capability in the rear ensure flexibility for passengers or cargo, accommodating your evolving needs whether transporting seven occupants or maximizing storage space. The 10-way power driver seat with thigh support, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats provide personalized comfort for all occupants.

Technology integration enhances both convenience and safety. The navigation system paired with the 14-speaker Meridian audio system ensures entertainment throughout your journeys, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you connected to your devices. The heads-up display projects essential information onto the windshield, minimizing visual distractions during drives.

Safety features are comprehensive, including active cruise control, electronic stability control, traction control, and a full suite of airbags strategically positioned throughout the cabin. The navigation system, remote keyless entry, and 911 Connect emergency communication system add layers of protection and peace of mind for you and your family.

The Towing Package, complete with tow hitch, expands this Telluride's practical applications, enabling you to bring along boats, trailers, or recreational equipment for your adventures. Combined with the power liftgate and ample cargo space, this vehicle transitions seamlessly between daily responsibilities and weekend excursions.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this well-appointed Telluride Hybrid firsthand, exploring its spacious cabin and advanced features in person.

description:
This 2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid in striking black offers the three-row versatility and efficiency families demand in today's market.

- 14 Speaker Meridian Audio System
- Navigation System
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Heads-Up Display
- Power Moonroof
- Active Cruise Control
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Rear Seats
- Power Liftgate
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front and Rear Air Conditioning
- Memory Seat and Power Driver Seat with Thigh Support
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Fog Lights
- 911 Connect Emergency Communication System
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter
- Alloy Wheels with Rain Sensing Wipers

The hybrid powertrain pairs a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine with advanced efficiency technology, delivering capable performance while maintaining practical fuel economy. The six-speed automatic transmission with all-wheel drive ensures smooth acceleration and confident handling in diverse driving conditions.

With seating for up to eight passengers across three rows, this Telluride Hybrid accommodates your entire family or group with ease. Split-folding rear seats and a reclining third row expand your configuration options, whether transporting passengers or cargo. The power liftgate opens hands-free convenience for loading groceries or luggage.

Premium comfort features set this vehicle apart for long journeys. Heated and ventilated front seats adapt to your preferences, while heated rear seating extends comfort to back-row passengers. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic temperature control ensure personalized climate settings for driver and front passenger. Memory seating allows you to save your preferred driving position and return to it automatically.

Modern technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. The navigation system guides you turn-by-turn while the heads-up display projects essential information onto the windshield. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connect your smartphone, keeping you focused on the road while accessing navigation, messaging, and audio apps. The 14-speaker Meridian audio system and SiriusXM satellite radio deliver premium entertainment throughout the cabin.

Safety systems provide comprehensive protection for every occupant. Dual front airbags, front side-impact airbags, knee airbags, rear side-impact airbags, and overhead airbags surround passengers with impact protection. Active cruise control manages highway traffic, while electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip during challenging maneuvers. A rear parking camera assists with visibility during tight backing situations, and the 911 Connect emergency system provides rapid assistance when needed.

This three-row hybrid SUV balances practical family transportation with efficient operation, premium comfort, and modern safety technology to meet your journey today and tomorrow.

This 2025 Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star delivers capability and comfort in a truck designed to handle whatever comes your way. With a 3.0L Twin Turbocharged I-6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, you get the power and control needed for both highway driving and jobsite work, achieving 17 city and 24 highway MPG.

- Big Horn Level 2 Equipment Group with premium connectivity
- 12 Touchscreen Uconnect 5 Navigation Display with Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto
- Heated front seats with power 8-way driver seat adjustment and lumbar support
- Heated leather-wrapped steering wheel
- 9 amplified speakers with subwoofer and SiriusXM w/360L satellite radio
- 20 aluminum painted wheels with all-season tires
- Night Edition styling with black exterior accents and premium power mirrors
- Rear power sliding window with defroster
- Remote tailgate release and ParkView backup camera
- Mopar black tubular side steps
- GPS navigation with connected travel and traffic services
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster
- Configurable drive modes with anti-spin differential rear axle
- 400W inverter with multiple power outlets for jobsite convenience

The Big Horn/Lone Star combines work-ready features with daily-drive comfort. The Night Edition styling package gives you a distinctive appearance with black exterior mirrors, headlamp bezels, grille surround, and tailgate handle, paired with accent-color door and tailgate handles that add visual character. Inside, deluxe cloth bucket seats with full-length console seating provide comfort during long hauls, while the 12 TFT color cluster display and premium overhead console keep essential information within easy view.

Technology integration makes this truck feel modern and connected. Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto put your phones capabilities on the 12 touchscreen, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage everything without taking your hands off the wheel. The integrated voice command system with Bluetooth ensures you stay connected safely and conveniently.

This truck is ready for work. The 3.55 rear axle ratio supports towing and hauling, while the configurable drive modes help you adapt to different road conditions. Mopar rubber floor mats protect the interior from dirt and damage, and the Mopar tubular side steps provide practical, protective styling that makes entry and exit easier.

Ram Certified Pre-Owned Gold backs this truck with comprehensive peace of mind. You receive a 125 Point Inspection, 12-Month/12,000 Mile limited warranty following the new car warranty expiration, and a 12 Month/12,000 Mile Extended Care Premium Warranty. Additional benefits include a $100 warranty deductible, roadside assistance, vehicle history report, car rental allowance, and a 3-month trial subscription for SiriusXM Guardian and satellite radio. This vehicle has been thoroughly reconditioned using authentic Mopar parts and is backed by Rams certified program for vehicles between 0-5 model years or under 75,000 miles.

Visit our showroom to experience the 2025 Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star and discover how this truck can serve your needs with reliability and style.

2022 Ford Bronco Outer Banks 4 Door 4x4 Equipment Group 313A High Package comes with the EcoBoost 2.3L I-4 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, Ti-VCT variable valve control, intercooled turbo engine and 10-speed automatic transmission, delivering a strong mix of power and smooth daily drivability. Running on regular unleaded fuel, this Bronco is built to handle weekday commuting and weekend exploring with the same confident attitude, while the Outer Banks trim brings a more refined feel to its rugged 4x4 character.

The Equipment Group 313A High Package adds meaningful comfort, visibility, and connectivity upgrades that make the Bronco easier to enjoy every day while still keeping its adventure-ready personality intact.

Wireless smartphone mirroring helps you stay connected to your favorite apps, music, and contacts without the hassle of cords, making the cabin feel cleaner and more convenient.

Forward collision mitigation adds extra peace of mind by helping the Bronco respond to sudden traffic changes before a close call turns into a bigger problem.

Front pedestrian impact prevention is a valuable layer of awareness in busy areas, helping support safer driving around neighborhoods, parking lots, and city streets.

The built-in mobile hotspot makes it easier for passengers to stay online wherever the road leads, which is especially helpful for long trips and busy schedules.

A rear camera gives you a clearer view behind the vehicle, making reversing into tight spaces and backing out of driveways more manageable.

Lane departure prevention can help correct unintended drifting, which is especially useful on longer drives when attention may start to fade.

Predictive brake assist helps prepare for harder stops when traffic slows quickly, giving the driver another useful edge in unexpected situations.

Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls helps reduce fatigue on the highway by letting you hold a steady pace with less effort.

The voice activated integrated navigation system makes route guidance simpler, so you can focus on the drive instead of juggling directions or screens.

Keyfob vehicle start control lets you start the Bronco remotely, helping the cabin feel ready before you even open the door.

With its turbocharged powertrain, 10-speed automatic, and a well-rounded mix of comfort, convenience, and safety technology, this 2022 Ford Bronco Outer Banks 4 Door 4x4 is a smart fit for drivers who want capability without giving up everyday usability. It brings together the Bronco s go-anywhere spirit and the features shoppers appreciate most in a modern SUV.

Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. 2021 Toyota Tacoma SR | 2.7L | 4WD | Convenience Package | Bed Upgrades

This 2021 Toyota Tacoma SR in white is built for drivers who want dependable 4WD capability with practical features for both work and weekend adventures, backed by Toyotas proven truck engineering. With 52,000 miles, a 2.7L engine, 6-speed automatic transmission, and thoughtfully equipped bed and interior, its ready for daily use and off-hours projects.

Under the hood, the 2.7L SMPI DOHC engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability gives you an EPA-estimated 19 mpg in the city and 22 mpg on the highway, offering a balance of usable power with practical fuel economy. The 4.30 axle ratio helps provide torque for a variety of road conditions, while speed-sensing steering and the front anti-roll bar contribute to confident handling when youre driving through town or on rougher roads.

The SR trim includes ownership-focused touches that make this Tacoma easier to live with. The SR Convenience Package adds remote keyless entry and illuminated entry lighting for nighttime convenience. The bed is set up for real use with a Bed Lighting Kit for visibility after dark, a Bed Mat to help protect the surface and keep cargo from sliding, and 5 black oval tube steps that make getting in and out of the cab or accessing the bed less of a strain. Door edge guards are already in place to help protect against parking lot dings. All Weather Floor Liners and Door Sill Protectors help keep the interior cleaner when you bring in mud, dirt, or snow.

Safety receives serious attention. This Tacoma features dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints, all engineered to help protect occupants in various scenarios. Electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, and front and rear stability aids work together to support control on wet, uneven, or loose surfaces. A rear exterior parking camera helps with visibility when backing up, and Toyota Safety Connect with a 1-year trial adds an emergency communication layer if you need assistance. Auto high-beam headlights further help with nighttime driving by automatically adjusting to conditions.

Inside, the cab is designed for truck owners who value straightforward functionality. Front bucket seats offer comfortable support, while power windows and power door mirrors add everyday ease. Steering wheel mounted audio controls let you adjust sound without taking your hands off the wheel, and the tilt-and-telescoping steering wheel helps you find a comfortable driving position. The 6-speaker audio system delivers clear sound, with SiriusXM radio, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto integration giving you simple access to music, calls, navigation apps, and more.

If you are looking for a mid-size 4WD truck with Toyota reliability, a 2.7L engine and 6-speed automatic transmission, SR Convenience Package, all-weather floor protection, bed lighting and mat, 5 black tube steps, rear camera, Toyota Safety Connect, and straightforward smartphone integration, this 2021 Toyota Tacoma SR deserves a closer look.

The entertainment system features Entune Display Audio with a 6.1-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio, CD player, and MP3/WMA playback capability. Bluetooth connectivity enables hands-free phone functionality with phone book access and music streaming. The system also includes advanced voice recognition for safer operation while driving, along with Siri Eyes Free for Apple device integration.

This RAV4 XLE represents the practical, capable choice for buyers who value reliability, safety, and thoughtful design. Visit our showroom today to experience this crossover firsthand and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.

This 2016 Lexus RX 350 represents a sophisticated choice for those seeking a premium midsize luxury SUV with proven reliability and refined craftsmanship.

- Leather interior with Espresso Walnut trim

Safety is paramount in this RX, with Lexus Safety System Plus providing comprehensive collision avoidance technology. The pre-collision system with pedestrian detection, lane departure alert with steering assist, and all-speed dynamic radar cruise control work together to help keep you and your passengers protected.

Practical features round out the package. The power liftgate, intuitive parking assist, and rear cross traffic alert make daily driving and parking straightforward. The premium package adds driver seat memory, easy exit functionality, and aluminum roof rails for versatility.

This Lexus RX 350 offers the balance of luxury, safety, and practicality that discerning buyers expect from this nameplate. We invite you to visit our showroom for a closer look and test drive.

The 2018 GMC Acadia SLT-1 is a well-appointed three-row family SUV designed to accommodate your evolving lifestyle. With Quicksilver Metallic exterior paint and 67,316 miles on the odometer, this vehicle presents a practical choice for buyers seeking a versatile crossover with room for passengers and cargo alike.

Under the hood, the 2.5L four-cylinder DGI DOHC engine with variable valve timing delivers balanced performance paired with a six-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. This combination achieves 21 city and 26 highway MPG, offering reasonable fuel efficiency for a vehicle in this class. The 3.87 axle ratio supports stable highway driving and everyday commuting.

Interior comfort is supported by multiple convenience features including heated front seats, power-adjustable driver seating, and climate zones that allow front and rear passengers to set their preferred temperatures independently. The perforated leather-appointed trim adds a layer of refinement to daily driving. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading, while the rear window wiper and defroster enhance functionality during varied weather conditions.

Safety systems include dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags distributed throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, ABS brakes on all four wheels, and a tire pressure monitoring system work together to help maintain vehicle control. OnStar and GMC connected services provide emergency communication capabilities, and the exterior rear-view camera assists with parking and reversing.

The Acadias infotainment setup centers on an 8 color touchscreen with full compatibility for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing seamless smartphone integration. SiriusXM satellite radio with standard AM/FM rounds out audio options. Steering wheel-mounted controls keep audio and phone management within easy reach, and the trip computer displays key operational data at a glance.

This 2015 Ford F-150 Lariat stands ready to handle your toughest demands with proven capability and lasting reliability. Built for owners who expect professional-grade performance without compromise, this white pickup combines practical truck engineering with genuine comfort features that make every drive more enjoyable.

- Remote Start System
- LED Side-Mirror Spotlights with high-intensity security approach lamps
- Blind Spot Information System (BLIS) with cross-traffic alert
- Power-folding heated mirrors with auto-dimming driver's side
- 110V/400W Outlet
- Reverse Sensing System
- Auxiliary Transmission Oil Cooler
- Upgraded Front Stabilizer Bar
- Chrome 3-Bar Style Grille with chrome surround
- Chrome Angular Step Bars and chrome door handles
- 18 Chrome-Like PVD wheels
- Single-Tip Chrome Exhaust
- Spray-In Bedliner (Pre-Installed)
- Medium earth gray leather-trimmed heated and cooled power seats
- Universal Garage Door Opener

The 2.7L V6 EcoBoost engine delivers balanced power while maintaining fuel efficiency, averaging 18 city and 23 highway miles per gallon. Paired with the 6-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive, this truck navigates various road conditions with confidence. The electronic locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio provides the traction needed for both work and weekend adventures.

Inside, the Lariat trim emphasizes driver comfort with medium earth gray leather-trimmed bucket seats featuring 10-way power adjustment, heating, and cooling capabilities on both front seats. The driver's seat includes memory settings that save your preferred position. Heated door mirrors, an auto-dimming rear-view mirror, and telescoping steering wheel adjust to your preference. SYNC with MyFord Touch keeps you connected, while SiriusXM satellite radio and the seven-speaker audio system provide quality entertainment.

The Trailer Tow Package includes an auxiliary transmission oil cooler and upgraded front stabilizer bar, ensuring safe towing when needed. The Class IV trailer hitch receiver provides substantial capability for most pulling applications. Exterior parking camera with reverse sensing helps you see obstacles and navigate tight spaces with greater awareness.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing technology. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confidence-building stopping power. Speed-sensing power steering adjusts to vehicle speed for better control, while the front anti-roll bar promotes stability.

This F-150 Lariat offers the quality construction and feature-rich experience Lariat owners expect. Schedule your visit today to see how this truck can serve your needs and exceed your expectations.

description:
This 2016 Subaru Impreza 2.0i delivers reliable everyday performance with practical features designed for real-world driving needs.

- 2.0L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V engine with CVT Lineartronic transmission
- All-Wheel Drive for confident handling in varied conditions
- Subaru Starlink 6.2 Multimedia System with AM/FM radio and CD player
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear for added safety and convenience
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Dual front impact airbags plus dual front side impact airbags
- Knee airbag and overhead airbag protection
- Emergency communication system
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Reclining front bucket seats with front center armrest
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- Air conditioning and rear window defroster

This Impreza achieves 28 city MPG and 37 highway MPG, making it efficient for both commuting and longer drives. The 2.0L four-cylinder engine provides steady power while the CVT transmission offers smooth acceleration. All-Wheel Drive comes standard, giving you the confidence to handle rain, snow, or gravel roads with greater traction and stability.

The interior strikes a practical balance between comfort and functionality. Cloth upholstery is easy to maintain, while the front bucket seats recline for added comfort on longer trips. The split folding rear seat expands your cargo options when you need them. Climate control includes air conditioning and a rear window defroster to keep all occupants comfortable year-round.

Safety has been engineered throughout this vehicle. Multiple airbags, including front, side, knee, and overhead units, work with Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and ABS brakes to help protect you and your passengers. The Exterior Parking Camera Rear provides visual feedback when backing up, and the Emergency Communication System adds an extra layer of security.

The exterior green finish is complemented by body-color bumpers and a sporty spoiler. Power door mirrors, a rear window wiper, and variably intermittent wipers handle weather and visibility needs. The 15-inch steel wheels with full covers are durable and practical for daily use.

With 32,399 miles, this Impreza has been carefully maintained and is ready for its next owner. Its straightforward design and proven Subaru engineering mean you can drive with confidence. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this vehicle in person and experience the quality build and reliable performance Subaru owners depend on.

The 4-wheel drive system provides the traction and control you need for varied driving conditions, while the responsive steering and independent front suspension ensure confident handling.

The interior combines functionality with comfort. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature, while heated front seats provide warmth on cold mornings. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a refined touch, and the comprehensive gauge cluster including a trip computer keeps you informed about your vehicle's performance.

Safety has been engineered throughout this vehicle. Six airbags protect occupants in multiple impact scenarios, including dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability and traction control work together to maintain grip during challenging maneuvers, while the low tire pressure warning system alerts you to any issues before they become problems. Safety Connect provides peace of mind with emergency communication capabilities.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamlessly integrated. The Toyota Audio Multimedia System supports both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to access your phone's navigation and music wirelessly. SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options, while steering wheel mounted controls let you manage audio without taking your eyes off the road.

Factor in the reminder of factory warranty coverage on this vehicle, and you have a Land Cruiser ready to serve you reliably. We encourage you to visit our showroom to inspect this unit firsthand and experience its capabilities in person.
